title: Make Button and Accent Token System 100% Variable-Driven Across All Pages
description: Per user directive ('buttons on footer and other pages does not got the new change. make it fully robust. and hence changing variables should update the website.'), engineered a 100% variable-driven button, CTA, and accent system across the entire application. Replaced all legacy hardcoded hexes (#C5A059, #B38F48, #6B1C23, text-[#1A1A1A] on buttons) with semantic CSS tokens (--color-accent, --color-accent-hover, --color-accent-contrast, --color-accent-light, --color-accent-tint). Aliased legacy --color-gold, --color-gold-hover, --color-accent-gold, and --color-gold-bright to var(--color-accent) in app/globals.css so existing components automatically update. Updated Footer, RFQ Portal, Cart, Wishlist, Login, Account, Search Modal & Page, FAQ, and Service Detail pages. Authored tests/task-34-robust-theme-variables.spec.ts verifying computed styles in dark and light modes, as well as dynamic runtime CSS variable updates across routes. Captured 12 high-resolution visual proof screenshots in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to parent brain directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Design tokens in app/globals.css define --color-accent, --color-accent-hover, --color-accent-light, --color-accent-tint, and --color-accent-contrast across :root, .dark, and .light
Legacy tokens (--color-gold, --color-gold-hover, --color-gold-bright, --color-accent-gold) are aliased to var(--color-accent) and var(--color-accent-hover)
Footer newsletter button uses bg-accent hover:bg-accent-hover text-[var(--color-accent-contrast)] with focus:ring-accent
RFQ Portal primary action buttons, step indicators, progress bars, and focus rings use semantic accent tokens with zero remaining hardcoded gold hexes
Cart page checkout CTA, counter badge, delivery toggle, and radio focus rings use semantic accent tokens
Wishlist page move-all-to-cart, discover, and add-to-cart action buttons use semantic accent tokens
Login page authentication submit button uses bg-accent hover:bg-accent-hover text-[var(--color-accent-contrast)]
Account dashboard action buttons, add-address CTAs, checkboxes, and input focus rings use semantic accent tokens
Search modal and search page category filter pills and action CTAs use semantic accent tokens
FAQ consultation button uses semantic accent tokens
Service detail hero, estimator, and CTA banner use semantic accent tokens
Dynamically changing --color-accent at runtime immediately cascades to all buttons across the entire website without code edits
All semantic data-testid hooks are strictly preserved
Zero TypeScript and build errors on npm run build across all 19 static and dynamic routes
100% pass rate across automated test suites (tests/task-34-robust-theme-variables.spec.ts 8/8 passing, tests/task-33-peacock-teal-theme.spec.ts 6/6 passing)
12 visual proof screenshots captured in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to /Users/pritish/.gemini/antigravity/brain/91fc1fed-fc5f-495e-88c1-129ef76052af/
